## Variables

### GenerationFrame

```ts
const GenerationFrame: ForwardRefExoticComponent<
  object &
    Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "children"> &
    RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement>
>;
```

One fixed frame for a generation, from queued to done: the frame keeps its size
the whole time, so nothing around it moves. The finished media develops inside
it (it sharpens out of a soft blur), and a failure dims the frame behind its
message. Reduced motion keeps short fades only.
